title: Core Assurance Glossary
description: Canonical terms for FR, TBT, evidence, rulesets and assurance framework traceability.

terms.definition: A project-owned requirement describing behaviour the application must provide. It is informed by standards and project context, then mapped to compliance ruleset rows and proven by one or more TBTs.
terms.tooltip: Project-owned functional requirement, proven by one or more TBTs.

terms.definition: A test, scanner, review or approval basis used to prove one or more Functional Requirements.
terms.tooltip: The basis for proving an FR, such as a test, scanner check, review or approval.

terms.definition: Observed or reviewed proof produced by a TBT, such as a test result, scanner result, document excerpt, approval record or screenshot.
terms.tooltip: Observed proof collected from a TBT.

terms.definition: A collection of compliance rows or controls, such as ASVS, NIST 800-53, CIS, ISO 27001 or PCI-DSS.
terms.tooltip: Compliance standard or control set, such as ASVS or NIST.

terms.definition: A single requirement, row or control inside a compliance ruleset.
terms.tooltip: A single row or control from a compliance ruleset.

terms.definition: A process framework such as JSP-453 that defines gates, roles, criteria, approvals, ceremonies and evidence expectations.
terms.tooltip: Process framework defining gates, roles, approvals and criteria.

terms.definition: Project-specific state for an assurance framework, including role assignments, criterion mappings, waivers, approvals and gate decisions.
terms.tooltip: Project-specific evidence, approvals and mappings for an assurance framework.

terms.definition: A party or responsibility group that must be involved in an assurance gate, such as owner, approver, consulted specialist or reviewer.
terms.tooltip: Party or responsibility group involved in passing an assurance gate.

terms.definition: A decision point in an assurance framework that must meet criteria and receive required involvement before the process continues.
terms.tooltip: Assurance decision point with required criteria, roles and evidence.

terms.definition: A requirement within a gate that defines what must be true before the gate can pass.
terms.tooltip: A gate-level requirement used to decide readiness.

terms.definition: A UI grouping for related Functional Requirements, usually derived from the FR category field.
Project-specific selection of applicable ruleset levels, baselines, profiles, included rows and excluded rows.
terms.tooltip: Applicable ruleset levels, profiles and row selections for this project.

terms.definition: The rule that determines what evidence is sufficient for a TBT or gate criterion.
terms.tooltip: Rule for deciding whether evidence is sufficient.

terms.definition: Observed result for a piece of evidence: passed, failed, missing, manual review or waived.
Authoring lifecycle for an FR or TBT, such as draft, in scope, planned, implemented, deferred, retired or deprecated.
terms.tooltip: Authoring lifecycle of an FR or TBT.

terms.definition: Human approval state, such as pending, approved, rejected or waived.
Derived readiness for a gate or criterion, such as ready, blocked, partial, manual review or waived.
terms.tooltip: Derived readiness for a gate or criterion.

terms.definition: Precise location inside an evidence artifact, such as page, section, paragraph, line range or excerpt.
terms.tooltip: Pinpoint location inside an evidence artifact.
